stories.title: Verify the 10-tab stepper, progress fill and narrow-width scroll
stories.scope: Deployed tour at https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/tour (static assets dir ./ui per platform/wrangler.jsonc). Proof-only, no rebuild. Elements: platform/ui/tour.html (.step-btn tabs 0..9, 10 .step-card panels, #progress-fill, #step-display-indicator, #btn-prev/#btn-next/#btn-restart-tour); platform/ui/tour.js goToStep() and the stepper click delegate; platform/ui/tour.css .step-indicators { overflow-x: auto }.
stories.acceptance: 10 clickable tabs labelled '0. Intro' ... '9. Your Role' and 10 step panels exist; clicking tab N activates step N and sets the progress fill to (N+1)/10 x 100%; Next/Prev move one step, Next reads 'Finish Tour' on step 9, Restart returns to step 0; at a 360px viewport the stepper scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth > clientWidth, overflow-x auto) with all 10 tabs still present.

stories.acceptance: Step 6 fetches the live /proposals?base=demo API (status line 'Live connection established: Loaded N proposals from nextgit-platform'); 4 real proposal cards (agent-1..agent-4) render inside the tour; agent-1 and agent-2 - the live conflicting pair on src/auth.ts - carry 'Collides on src/auth.ts' while the remaining live proposals carry 'Clean & ready to ship'. stories.acceptance: Mobile-friendly stacking: at a 720px viewport the annotated two-pane layout collapses to a single column and the header wraps; at 640px the quiz options, scope grid and collision snippets are single-column; at 360px the term cards are single-column and exactly one step panel is active. All 10 step tabs remain reachable (narrow-width stepper scroll covered by E9-verify-stepper-nav).
stories.check_cmd: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node -e 'const {chromium}=require("@playwright/test");const F=[];const ok=(c,m)=>{if(!c)F.push(m)};const oneCol=async(l)=>await l.evaluate(e=>getComputedStyle(e).gridTemplateColumns.split(" ").length===1);(async()=>{const b=await chromium.launch();const p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:720,height:900}});await p.route("**/proposals*",r=>r.abort());await p.goto("https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/tour",{waitUntil:"domcontentloaded",timeout:60000});await p.locator(".step-btn").nth(3).click();await p.waitForSelector("#step-3.is-active");ok(await oneCol(p.locator(".annotated-layout")),"annotated layout single column at 720px");ok((await p.locator(".tour-header-top").evaluate(e=>getComputedStyle(e).flexWrap))==="wrap","header wraps at 720px");await p.setViewportSize({width:640,height:900});await p.waitForTimeout(300);await p.locator(".step-btn").nth(7).click();ok(await oneCol(p.locator(".quiz-options")),"quiz options single column at 640px");await p.locator(".step-btn").nth(8).click();ok(await oneCol(p.locator(".scope-grid")),"scope grid single column at 640px");await p.locator(".step-btn").nth(4).click();ok(await oneCol(p.locator(".sim3-snippets")),"collision snippets single column at 640px");await p.setViewportSize({width:360,height:800});await p.waitForTimeout(300);await p.locator(".step-btn").nth(0).click();ok(await oneCol(p.locator(".terms-grid")),"term cards single column at 360px");ok(await p.locator(".step-btn").count()===10&&await p.locator(".step-card.is-active").count()===1,"one active panel at 360px");await b.close();if(F.length){console.error("FAIL: "+F.join(" | "));process.exit(1)}console.log("E9-verify-mobile-stacking PASS: single-column stacking at 720/640/360")})().catch(e=>{console.error("FAIL:",e.message);process.exit(1)});'
stories.notes: Covers FR-38 consequence 2. Observation (not asserted, no story authored): at 360px hidden .glossary-tooltip elements extend document scrollWidth ~54px (position:absolute tooltips in tour.css); outside FR-38's stated single-column consequence, recorded for review.
